instruction: Create WebDAV user with davfs2 secrets and mount as normal user
output: echo 'http://localhost/webdav alice secret123' > ~/.davfs2/secrets && chmod 600 ~/.davfs2/secrets && mount.davfs http://localhost/webdav ~/webdav

instruction: Configure davfs2 to not use locks
Set davfs2 table size for large directories
Set davfs2 timeout for slow connections
List all WebDAV methods supported with curl OPTIONS
output: curl -X OPTIONS http://localhost/webdav/ --user alice:secretpass -I 2>&1 | grep -i '^Allow:' | tr ',' '\n'

instruction: Create and lock a file on WebDAV, then unlock in sequence
output: echo 'Content' > /tmp/test.txt && curl -X PUT http://localhost/webdav/test.txt --data-binary @/tmp/test.txt --user alice:secretpass && LOCK_TOKEN=$(curl -X LOCK http://localhost/webdav/test.txt --user alice:secretpass -H 'Content-Type: text/xml' -d '<D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:exclusive/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype></D:lockinfo>' -D - 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'Lock-Token' | tr -d '\r') && curl -X UNLOCK http://localhost/webdav/test.txt --user alice:secretpass -H "Lock-Token: $LOCK_TOKEN"
echo 'DAVMinPropTimeOut 120' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/dav-minprop-global.conf && sudo a2enconf dav-minprop-global && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Run ownCloud occ command to update app from marketplace

output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ config:system:set mail_domain --value=example.com && sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ config:system:set mail_from_address --value=noreply
